status: expressive mappings and bounded physical previews completed
mapping: hands to LF/RF only; feet to LM/LR and RM/RR only; shared root balance compensation
method: video features with manually adapted four-leg contact timing and reviewed right-kick phases
validation_scope: Not exact human-motion reconstruction, robust policy validation, or hardware validation

fixed_support_dance_compatibility.reason:
the reference does not describe a posture the robot can stand in: forward kinematics puts the four support feet 6.7 mm out of plane on the median frame (tolerance 5 mm).
REFERENCE is 'measured'. The commanded channels are PD *targets* and are expected to fail this -- nothing ever required forward kinematics on them to close. Use 'measured', or check that the base pose and the joint angles come from the same take.
fixed_support_dance_compatibility.note: The existing dance converter assumes all four legs stay grounded; stepping and kicking intentionally violate that assumption.
